tex_content.html:
Lemma
[smoothness of the bracket field]

↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-2

1. ch0:5.2If $X$ and $Y$ are smooth vector fields, then their bracket $[X,Y]$ is a smooth vector field.
Proof

\sketch

In each parametrization, write $X=\sum _i a_i\frac{\partial }{\partial x_i}$ and $Y=\sum _j b_j\frac{\partial }{\partial x_j}$. By section 4, the bracket has coefficients $\sum _i(a_i\partial _i b_j-b_i\partial _i a_j)$. These coefficients are smooth because the coefficients of $X$ and $Y$ are smooth, so the local expressions define a smooth vector field on each chart. Since the bracket was constructed uniquely, the local smooth fields agree on overlaps and glue to a smooth global vector field.

□
